name: Shivamshree Businesses Limited
about: Shivamshree Businesses Limited engages electric power generation using solar energy. The company is involved in trading of specialized commodities, including solar cells, photovoltaic cells, and solar panels. It also provides flexible intermediate bulk container (FIBC) and jumbo bags for packaging solution; storage and transportation of a wide range of materials, such as chemicals, food, metal, etc.; FIBC/jumbo bag fabric rolls; FIBC liners; geotextile fabric; and tarpaulin. The company also exports its products. Shivamshree Businesses Limited was formerly known as Siddarth Businesses Limited and changed its name to Shivamshree Businesses Limited in May 2016. The company was incorporated in 1983 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
